readings: For each observatory (`observstation` in the telescopes table), count its telescopes and work out its share of all telescopes. Then, taking only the observatories whose share is above the average share across all observatories, give a single summary row: their average telescope count, their average share, and how far on average their share sits above the average share. Don't round anything.
queries:
WITH counts AS (
  SELECT observstation, COUNT(*) AS cnt,
         COUNT(*) * 1.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM telescopes) AS share
  FROM telescopes
  GROUP BY observstation
),
avg_share AS (
  SELECT AVG(share) AS a FROM counts
)
SELECT AVG(cnt) AS avg_telescope_count,
       AVG(share) AS avg_share,
       AVG(share - (SELECT a FROM avg_share)) AS avg_share_above_average
FROM counts
WHERE share > (SELECT a FROM avg_share);
